business_problem: Coocaa needed to improve smart-TV retention by understanding both users and content at a scale too large for manual tagging and then matching viewers to the right programs.
solution_summary: Coocaa Network and Baidu AI Cloud built a recommendation and content-understanding stack for smart TV, with Baidu's MCA media-content-analysis service acting as the content intelligence layer. Instead of depending on editors to watch and tag every title, the platform analyzes long-form video through scene classification, public-face recognition and Baidu knowledge-graph enrichment so movies, TV series, variety shows, animation, games and documentaries gain much richer metadata. That structured description is then paired with user-preference signals in Coocaa's smart-AI business module to power recommendation and, ultimately, a TV-side information flow tailored to each household. The result is a two-sided architecture: MCA and knowledge graph transform raw video into structured tags, while the recommendation layer uses those tags to match content to viewers across many verticals. In practice, that lets the TV experience feel less static and more personalized without requiring infeasible amounts of manual content labeling.

solution_components.name: Content Analysis
solution_components.role: Provides the high-level content-understanding layer for smart-TV recommendation.

solution_components.name: MCA Media Content Analysis
solution_components.role: Extracts tags from long-form video across scene, people and semantic dimensions.

solution_components.name: Public Face Recognition
solution_components.role: Identifies celebrities and public figures appearing in video content.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Graph
solution_components.role: Adds structured metadata such as series names, actors, roles and genres to video assets.

data_flow: Long-form video is analyzed by MCA and knowledge-graph services to generate structured tags, then those tags are combined with user-preference signals in the recommendation system to build personalized TV-side information streams.
business_outcome: Coocaa made its TV experience more personalized and dynamic, improving content matching and giving the large-screen channel a stronger reason to retain viewer attention.
metrics: The catalog includes 16,000+ films, 4,000+ TV series and 3,100+ variety programs.
architecture_clues: The system combines scene classification, face recognition and knowledge-graph enrichment
Recommendation is built on both user understanding and content understanding
The outcome is a TV-side information flow rather than a static catalog
